inline_comments: Converts AGT agent manifests to/from OCI manifest format with AI Card compatibility. Enables registry-based discovery and verification of agent metadata.
Convert an AGT agent identity to an AI Card.
Convert an AI Card back to an AGT agent identity.
Package an agent identity and optional policy rules into an OCI manifest.
Extract an AI Card from an OCI manifest's layers.
Extract policy rules from an OCI manifest's layers.
Verify the integrity of an OCI manifest by checking layer digests.

functions.name: identityToAICard
functions.doc: Convert an AGT agent identity to an AI Card.

functions.name: aiCardToIdentity
functions.doc: Convert an AI Card back to an AGT agent identity.

functions.name: unpackPolicies
functions.doc: Extract policy rules from an OCI manifest's layers.

classes.name: OciManifestAdapter
classes.doc: Converts AGT agent manifests to OCI manifest format with AI Card   compatibility. Enables registry-based discovery and verification of   agent metadata.
